hooks.command: if git status --porcelain -- src src-tauri | grep -q . && ! git status --porcelain -- .claude/tests.md | grep -q .; then printf '%s' '{"decision":"block","reason":"Behaviour under src/ or src-tauri/ changed and .claude/tests.md was not updated. Add a dated section at the top listing exactly what the user has to check on screen: one unchecked box per check, each naming the command to run and what should happen. Cover what this turn changed and nothing else. Then stop."}'; fi
